clues: This hillside town sits in the highlands of southern Tanzania in East Africa. It lies south of the city of Mbeya.
Rain falls here almost all through the year. It comes from Lake Nyasa, and it keeps the hills green all year.
Long ago this land was ruled by Germany. In those days the town went by a German name.
People here speak a local tongue called Nyakyusa. They also speak Swahili, the tongue of the whole country.
Here the air stays mild to cool all year. It can drop to ten degrees in May and June.
